calon-mahasiswa.title: Untuk Calon Mahasiswa (Siswa SMA/SMK)
calon-mahasiswa.desc: Ingin berkarir di bidang Cyber Security? D4 Rekayasa Keamanan Siber Polibatam menawarkan studi 8 semester berbasis praktikum hands-on, sertifikasi internasional (CEH, Cisco), dan jaminan magang industri.

mahasiswa.title: Untuk Mahasiswa Aktif & Praktisi
mahasiswa.desc: Akses silabus CPL Capaian Pembelajaran, persiapan sertifikasi EC-Council & Cisco, jadwal ujian, dan laboratorium SOC untuk pengerjaan Project Based Learning (PBL).

industri.title: Untuk Mitra Industri, Perusahaan & BUMN
industri.desc: Bekerja sama dengan RKS Polibatam untuk rekrutmen talenta Cyber Security, program magang industri 1-2 semester, proyek riset terapan CSIRT, dan konsultasi keamanan siber.

orang-tua.title: Untuk Orang Tua / Wali Mahasiswa
orang-tua.desc: Program Studi D4 RKS terakreditasi LAM INFOKOM & berstandar IABEE dengan prospek kerja yang sangat tinggi di sektor perbankan, BUMN, instansi pemerintah, dan SOC global.

alumni.title: Untuk Alumni RKS
alumni.desc: Tetap terhubung dengan jaringan Alumni RKS Polibatam, pembaruan sertifikasi profesi tingkat lanjut, dan program Tracer Study.

calon-mahasiswa.title: 🎓 Information for Prospective Students (High School Graduates)
calon-mahasiswa.desc: Aspiring to build a career in Cybersecurity? D4 Cyber Security Engineering at Polibatam offers an 8-semester hands-on curriculum with global certifications (CEH, Cisco) and guaranteed industry internships.

mahasiswa.title: Information for Current Students & Practitioners
mahasiswa.desc: Access the 10 CPL learning outcomes, EC-Council & Cisco exam prep, exam schedules, and SOC labs for Project-Based Learning (PBL) industry tasks.

industri.title: Information for Industry & Enterprise Partners
industri.desc: Partner with RKS Polibatam for Cybersecurity talent recruitment, 1-2 semester full-time internships, applied CSIRT research projects, and security consulting.

orang-tua.title: Information for Parents & Guardians
orang-tua.desc: D4 RKS is accredited Excellent by LAM INFOKOM and IABEE standards, assuring top-tier employment prospects in banking, government, and global SOCs.

alumni.title: Information for RKS Alumni
alumni.desc: Stay connected with the RKS Alumni Network, advance your professional certifications, and participate in annual Tracer Study initiatives.
